{{Quote|The Empire's chemical weapons division has developed a deadly new poison: Ziroxin-12. The chemical is being produced in massive quantities at a space station in the remote Llanic system.|[[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] briefing|<ref name="LSS">{{TORcite|type=space|Llanic Station Strike}}</ref>}}
The '''Llanic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Llanic/Legends|Llanic]].

A [[Battle of the Llanic system|battle]] occurred inthe system during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] constructed a secret [[Space station/Legends|space station]], where was developed a new biological weapon, the [[Ziroxin-12/Legends|Ziroxin-12]]. However the Republic discovered the Sith's plans and sent the [[Coruscant Aegis]] to spearhead assault on the station.<ref name="LSS" />
